text:
Maya: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a 'mosaic + adaptor' strategy to incrementally carve cohesive tiles and add a thin adaptor layer that routes/normalizes traffic. intent is minimal blast radius and clearer ownership boundaries. want feedback on risks and rollout constraints.

Owen: I like smaller tiles. main concern is adaptor becoming a permanent antipattern. need strict TTL and delete plan.

Diego: agree. also worried about cost/latency. adaptor adds a hop. can we quantify expected p95 delta with our staging harness?

Priya: we can. rough numbers from a local spike: adaptor adds ~5ms median, 10-15ms p95 for larger payloads. but it simplifies feature toggles which reduces coordination time.

Maya: suggested rollout: 1) pick a low-risk tile (user-metadata enrich), 2) deploy adaptor in front but with route flagging, 3) run canary: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> flip, 4) monitor perf/errs for 24h at each step, 5) remove legacy path once coverage and diffs are acceptable. pre-reqs: load harness, integration + contract tests, quality diffs for LLM outputs.

Owen: add automated rollback thresholds: abort if p95 increases by >12% or error rate adds >0.3% over baseline. document rollback steps in runbook.

Diego: cache ownership question: adaptor must be stateless. tiles own caches. adaptor should only forward cache keys, not store copies.

Priya: tracing note: add span 'adaptor-hop' and tag tile_id and request_id. add a dashboard row for adaptor overhead.

Maya: quality: for any LLM proxied through the tile, run prompt-output diffing with the baseline promptset. fail canary if regression ratio > 0.5%. include human review step for borderline diffs.

unit-test-bot: tests: integration suite passed against adaptor-v1 (staging).

Owen: can we guard against adaptor config drift? propose a lint that ensures adaptor routing table entries are explicit and covered by tests.

Diego: also add a short-lived tech-debt ticket (90d) to delete adaptor after all tiles are live. include milestone dates and ownership.

Maya: sample feature-flag config I'll add to the RFC PR:
```json
{
  "service": "user-enrich",
  "adapter": "mosaic-adaptor-v1",
  "split": 2
}
```

Priya: make perf budget explicit in RFC and add automated check in CI that fails PRs if new adaptor code increases median by >8% on unit harness.

Maya: agreed. action items: I will update the RFC PR with rollout plan, perf budgets, test checklist, dashboard mockups, and the tech-debt ticket. tagging @Owen @Diego @Priya for review of the contracts and runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy: mosaic-adaptor-v1 canary started -> 0.5% (staging).

Diego: FYI saw a header normalization bug during dogfood, pushing a tiny fix that defaults missing tenant headers.

Owen: add a small KPI: adaptor-deletion-target and estimated story points so PMs can track.

Maya: will do. thanks everyone. :rocket:
